title: Nuclear Warhead
body:
"Use at your own risk. By activating this warhead, you may can use damage e to other player's based and lively hood. Usage of this bomb may cause depression, anxiety, or even death. Do not operate if you are pregnant, the owner of a cat, or very very cool."

Description

The Nuclear Warhead can be bought from the Dugg's Digging . It will be located on the ground floor from the waterfall (water descent ) side, under the stairs

Despite its appearance, it has a normal-sized explosion. This explosion, however, will fling any nearby objects absurdly far.

Trivia

  • This is the second most expensive item in the game with the price of $10,000,000, the most expensive being the Glass Ducky Case and the third being the Flamethrower.
